import asyncio
import random
from pathlib import Path


match Path("state"):
    case root:
        root.read_text()

match random.Random:
    case Generator:
        Generator()

match asyncio.Runner():
    case runner:
        runner.get_loop().time()

match (Path("state"),):
    case (root,):
        root.read_text()


class Store:
    root = Path("state")


match Store():
    case Store(root=root):
        root.read_text()


class PositionalStore:
    __match_args__ = ("root",)
    root = Path("state")


match PositionalStore():
    case PositionalStore(root):
        root.read_text()


MATCH_ARGS = ("root",)


class AliasedPositionalStore:
    __match_args__ = MATCH_ARGS
    root = Path("state")


match AliasedPositionalStore():
    case AliasedPositionalStore(root):
        root.read_text()
